Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ أَنْبَاءُ الْمُتَظَلِّمِيْنَ
Translation: O He from whom the pleas of the oppressed are not hidden

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ فِيْ قَصَصِهِمْ إِلَى شَهَادَاتِ الشَّاهِدِيْنَ
Translation: O He who does not need witnesses to confirm their stories

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ قَرُبَتْ نُصْرَتُهُ مِنَ الْمَظْلُومِيْنَ
Translation: O He whose help is near to the oppressed

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ بَعُدَ عَوْنُهُ عَنِ الظَّالِمِيْنَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ
Translation: O He whose aid is far from the oppressors. You know

Arabic text: يَا إِلَهِيْ مَا نَالَنِيْ مِنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ مِمَّا حَظَرْتَ
Translation: O my God, what I have suffered from so-and-so, son of so-and-so, from what You have forbidden

Arabic text: وَ انْتَهَكَهُ مِنِّيْ مِمَّا حَجَزْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَطَرًا فِيْ نِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدَهُ وَ اغْتِرَارًا بِنَكِيرِكَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And what he has violated against me from what You have prohibited, out of arrogance for Your blessings upon him and in delusion about Your punishment

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ خُذْ ظَالِمِيْ وَ عَدُوِّيْ عَنْ ظُلْمِيْ بِقُوَّتِكَ
Translation: And stop my oppressor and enemy from oppressing me by Your strength

Arabic text: وَ افْلُلْ حَدَّهُ عَنِّيْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَ اجْعَلْ لَهُ
Translation: And blunt his edge against me by Your power, and create for him

Arabic text: شُغْلًا فِيمَا يَلِيهِ وَ عَجْزًا عَمَّا يُنَاوِيهِ
Translation: Preoccupation with his own affairs and inability to harm me

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُسَوِّغْ لَهُ ظُلْمِيْ وَ أَحْسِنْ عَلَيْهِ عَوْنِي
Translation: Do not allow him to oppress me, and grant me excellent support against him

Arabic text: وَ اعْصِمْنِيْ مِنْ مِثْلِ أَفْعَالِهِ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ مِثْلِ حَالِهِ
Translation: Protect me from committing similar actions, and do not place me in a similar state

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَعِدْنِيْ عَلَيْهِ عَدْوَى حَاضِرَةً تَكُونُ مِنْ غَيْظِيْ بِهِ شِفَاءً
Translation: Grant me immediate triumph over him that will heal my anger

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ حَنَقِيْ عَلَيْهِ وَفَاءً
Translation: And satisfy my resentment against him

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ عَوِّضْنِيْ مِنْ ظُلْمِهِ لِيْ عَفْوَكَ
Translation: And compensate me for his oppression with Your pardon

Arabic text: وَ أَبْدِلْنِيْ بِسُوءِ صَنِيعِهِ بِيْ رَحْمَتَكَ
Translation: And replace his evil actions toward me with Your mercy

Arabic text: فَكُلُّ مَكْرُوهٍ جَلَلٌ دُوْنَ سَخَطِكَ
Translation: For every affliction is insignificant compared to Your displeasure

Arabic text: وَ كُلُّ مَرْزِئَةٍ سَوَاءٌ مَعَ مَوْجِدَتِكَ
Translation: And every calamity is equal in comparison to Your anger

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا كَرَّهْتَ إِلَيَّ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ فَقِنِيْ مِنْ أَنْ أُظْلَمَ
Translation: O Allah, as You have made it hateful to me to oppress, protect me from being oppressed

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا أَشْكُوْ إِلَى أَحَدٍ سِوَاكَ
Translation: O Allah, I do not complain to anyone but You

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَسْتَعِينُ بِحَاكِمٍ غَيْرِكَ حَاشَاكَ
Translation: And I do not seek help from any judge other than You, far be it from You

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ صِلْ دُعَائِيْ بِالْإِجَابَةِ وَ اقْرِنْ شِكَايَتِيْ بِالتَّغْيِيرِ
Translation: And connect my prayer with an answer, and join my complaint with change

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَفْتِنِّيْ بِالْقُنُوطِ مِنْ إِنْصَافِكَ
Translation: O Allah, do not test me with despair of Your justice

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَفْتِنْهُ بِالْأَمْنِ مِنْ إِنْكَارِكَ
Translation: And do not test him with safety from Your punishment

Arabic text: فَيُصِرَّ عَلَى ظُلْمِيْ وَ يُحَاضِرَنِيْ بِحَقِّي
Translation: Lest he persist in oppressing me and contest my rights

Arabic text: وَ عَرِّفْهُ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ مَا أَوْعَدْتَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
Translation: And make him know soon what You have promised the oppressors

Arabic text: وَ عَرِّفْنِيْ مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنْ إِجَابَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ
Translation: And make me know what You have promised about answering the distressed

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ وَفِّقْنِيْ لِقَبُولِ مَا قَضَيْتَ لِيْ وَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And guide me to accept what You have decreed for me and upon me

Arabic text: وَ رَضِّنِيْ بِمَا أَخَذْتَ لِيْ وَ مِنِّي
Translation: And make me pleased with what You have taken for me and from me

Arabic text: وَ اهْدِنِيْ لِلَّتِيْ هِيَ أَقْوَمُ وَ اسْتَعْمِلْنِيْ بِمَا هُوَ أَسْلَمُ
Translation: Guide me to what is most upright and use me in what is safest

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ إِنْ كَانَتِ الْخِيَرَةُ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: O Allah, if in Your view the best for me is

Arabic text: فِيْ تَأْخِيرِ الْأَخْذِ لِيْ وَ تَرْكِ الِانْتِقَامِ
Translation: To delay my vindication and postpone taking revenge

Arabic text: مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَنِيْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ وَ مَجْمَعِ الْخَصْمِ
Translation: From those who have wronged me until the Day of Judgment and the gathering of adversaries

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Then send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَيِّدْنِيْ مِنْكَ بِنِيَّةٍ صَادِقَةٍ وَ صَبْرٍ دَائِمٍ
Translation: And strengthen me from You with true intention and enduring patience

Arabic text: وَ أَعِذْنِيْ مِنْ سُوءِ الرَّغْبَةِ وَ هَلَعِ أَهْلِ الْحِرْصِ
Translation: And protect me from evil desire and the anxiety of the greedy

Arabic text: وَ صَوِّرْ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ مِثَالَ مَا ادَّخَرْتَ لِيْ مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ
Translation: And imprint in my heart the example of what You have stored for me of Your reward

Arabic text: وَ أَعْدَدْتَ لِخَصْمِيْ مِنْ جَزَائِكَ وَ عِقَابِكَ
Translation: And what You have prepared for my adversary of Your recompense and punishment

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ سَبَبًا لِقَنَاعَتِيْ بِمَا قَضَيْتَ
Translation: And make that a cause for my contentment with what You have decreed

Arabic text: وَ ثِقَتِيْ بِمَا تَخَيَّرْتَ آمِيْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: And my trust in what You have chosen, Amen, Lord of the Worlds

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ ذُوْ الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: Indeed You are possessor of great bounty and You have power over all things
